visual_review.assessment: Six complete crowned royal goblin poses preserve screen-right orb scepter, red white-fur cloak, crown, ornate gold jewelry and loaded sack. Opposite boot positions and knee loading vary, but phase order does not clearly follow the requested two three-phase half-strides. One bounded correction did not clearly improve cycle ordering; original kept.
